subject: Re: Quick hands-on session for your recent usage spike
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Akiva Morris <akiva@brightloop.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quick hands-on session for your recent usage spike

Hi Akiva —

Congrats on the early traction with BrightLoop’s integration — our system flagged a steady usage uptick this past week and I wanted to offer a short, no-sales walkthrough to help you convert that activity into a reliable production pattern. Typical call is 20–30 minutes and we cover:

- a quick look at your request/latency profile
- batching/cache knobs that often drop token cost by 15–30%
- a short checklist to avoid quota surprises during ramp

Would tomorrow or Wednesday work for a 20-minute hands-on run-through? I’ve CC’d Vanessa (your account rep) and Priyom (SDR) so we can line up the right folks.

If you prefer, here’s a calendar link to grab a slot: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/30min

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: BrightLoop_MAP_v1.pdf (mapping + suggested runbook)
From: Akiva Morris <akiva@brightloop.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-20T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick hands-on session for your recent usage spike

Thanks Ben — appreciate the reach-out.

We did a soft launch of a new parsing feature that hit heavier-than-expected traffic on the weekend. A short walkthrough sounds useful; we'd like to cover cost-saving suggestions and any quick reliability checks.

Tomorrow is tight for us (all-hands), but Wednesday afternoon PST or Thursday morning PST would be ideal. Also would like to have one of our engineering leads on the call — looping in Lena.

Cheers,
Akiva Morris
Head of Integrations, BrightLoop
akiva@brightloop.ai
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Akiva Morris <akiva@brightloop.ai>, Lena Park <lena@brightloop.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-20T11:25:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick hands-on session for your recent usage spike

Hi Akiva — great to meet you over email, and thanks for the context. I’ll run the session and make sure we have a short technical checklist + a live runbook we can hand off.

Proposed 20-minute slots (PST):
- Wed 2026-12-22 14:00–14:20
- Wed 2026-12-22 16:00–16:20
- Thu 2026-12-23 09:00–09:20

I can do the 16:00 slot if that works best — otherwise pick any and I’ll send a calendar invite. If Lena wants to dive deeper we can extend to 35 minutes and include a brief look at KV/cache sizing and the recommended quantization profile for your model family.

Prelude items (short):
1) If you can share one representative request/response and the typical sequence length, we’ll tune the demo.
2) If there are any compliance requests (SOC2, data retention) let me know so I can bring the right docs.

I attached the runbook template and the MAP Ben referenced so you have them ahead of time.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Attachments: runbook_template.zip, BrightLoop_MAP_v1.pdf
From: Lena Park <lena@brightloop.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Akiva Morris <akiva@brightloop.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-21T08:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick hands-on session for your recent usage spike

Thanks Vanessa — 16:00 PST on Wed looks good to me. Could we make it 35 minutes instead of 20? I want to include our infra lead briefly to confirm batching and a quick look at our telemetry.

Also, can you share any SOC2 artifacts or the standard security checklist in advance? Procurement will want to see the high-level answers before we expand usage.

Lena Park
Engineering Lead, BrightLoop
lena@brightloop.ai
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-12-21T15:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick hands-on session for your recent usage spike

Perfect — Wed 2026-12-22 16:00–16:35 PST is booked. Invite sent (see Calendly link + Google Meet).

I attached the two docs we referenced: BrightLoop_MAP_v1.pdf (runbook + suggested rollout steps) and a short security checklist summary. For SOC2 artifacts we can share a scoped package during the call and follow up with your procurement team via secure link.

Agenda (35 min):
- 5 min intros + goals
- 10 min traffic/profile + quick telemetry checks
- 12 min hands-on knobs (batching, KV cache, quantization suggestions)
- 5 min immediate next steps & handoff (MAP + action items)

If anything changes, reply here and Ben will help reschedule. Looking forward to it.

Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
